GLOSSARY 
DARANA or DARUNA. 
A Weapon that tears or splits asunder. 
DARPANA. 
The Drying-up Weapon. 
DASHAKSHA. The Ten-eyed Weapon. 
DASHASHIRSHA. 
The Ten-headed Weapon. 
DHANA. 
The Weapon that robs the enemy of his spoils. 
DHANYA. 
The Weapon that brings good fortune. 
DHARMA-ASTRA. 
The Weapon of Nemesis. 
DHARMANABHA. 
The Sacred-navelled Weapon. 
DHARMAPASHA. 
The Weapon that has the power of entangling 
the foe. 
DHARMASHAKRA. 
The Weapon of Justice or Virtue. 
DHRISHTA. 
The Active Weapon, a kind of Arrow. 
DHRITI. 
The Weapon of Forbearance. 
DITYA. 
The Titanic Weapon. 
DRIDHANABHA. 
The Weapon of firm Navel. 
DCNDUNABHA. 
A form of the Danda Weapon.
